messages:
incident-bot: Pager — high 5xx and gateway timeouts detected on gateway-prod (15min window). spike: 12.4% 5xx, 6% timeouts. topology: us-east-1 primary. link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/2100123456 :rotating_light:

omar (oncall): taking pager. looking at gateway logs now. assigning myself as handler.

lia (infra): noted. check the ingress autoscaler and edge ELB health. can you paste the failing route?

omar (oncall): route: /v1/generate -> backend pool gateway-runtime. quick tail:
```
[15:22:01] 502 gateway-runtime-32: upstream reset
[15:22:02] 504 gateway-runtime-17: rpc timeout (3000ms)
[15:22:03] 502 gateway-runtime-32: upstream reset
```

sarah (eng-runtime): did we push a runtime change in the last hour? I see a canary from 3h ago but nothing in last 45m. PR 1428 was an optimization for attention cache, merged yesterday. might be unrelated but checking.

omar (oncall): confirmed traffic spike correlates with a scheduled batch job hitting embeddings endpoint ~15:15. Also seeing sudden fanout to external partner integrations, amplifying backend load.

lia (infra): I'm scaling the gateway ASG + adding a temporary instance template with higher connection limit. infra-bot: apply scale +2.

infra-bot: action queued: asg/gateway-prod -> desired=18 (+2). estimated spin up ~90s.

omar (oncall): applying quick circuit-breaker rule on /v1/generate to limit max concurrent to 100 per pod to avoid meltdown. command:
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --circuit-breaker=max_concurrency=100 --reason="emergency mitigation"
```
omar (oncall): applied. will monitor.

pm-ryan: what's customer impact now? any major tenants affected?

omar (oncall): preliminary: ~120k requests failed in the last 15m, mostly short-lived SDKs and partner integrations. single-customer impact: partner-acme shows increased error budget consumption, support ticket 8672 opened. no broad data loss.

lia (infra): ASG scaled, new instances healthy. kernel ephemeral: increased connection_pool_limit on new template.

sarah (eng-runtime): I see error traces showing timeouts in our HTTP client to backend-models svc. stack: gateway -> runtime -> models. Might be backend saturation. I'm starting a quick rollback of the small runtime canary that was promoted earlier this week (rev 2026-09) to test.

omar (oncall): agree — if runtime change is causing tight resource loops, rollback quickest path. do it.

sarah (eng-runtime): rolling back canary -> command:
```
deployctl rollback runtime/gateway-runtime --to-revision=2026-08 --reason="emergency - reduce tail latency"
```
sarah (eng-runtime): rollback initiated. will post when complete.

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-2100123501).

[~4m later]

sarah (eng-runtime): rollback finished, routing verified. post-rollback 5xx dropped from 12.4% -> 3.1% in the past 5m. timeouts still at ~2.2%.

omar (oncall): visible improvement, good. still seeing timeouts from long-running partner requests. I'm putting a temporary rate limit on partner-acme integration and moving non-critical batch jobs to low-priority queue.

omar (oncall): commands:
```
redwoodctl integ update partner-acme --rate-limit=60rps --backoff=exponential
redwoodctl queue reprioritize batch/embeddings --priority=low
```

pm-ryan: can we estimate ETA to full recovery? customers need an update.

omar (oncall): with ASG up & rollback done, and partner throttling, I estimate SLO recovery within 20-30 minutes. I'll start a brief customer-facing blurb.

pm-ryan: please share text when ready.

omar (oncall): draft: "We experienced elevated 5xx and timeouts impacting some API requests in us-east-1 between 15:15–15:55 UTC. We applied an emergency mitigation (circuit breaker + scaling + rollback) and throttled partner traffic; service is recovering. Engineers continue to monitor. We will follow up with a post-incident report." :thumbsup:

lia (infra): followups: update the autoscaler policy to react faster to short spikes (scale out threshold -> 60s), and add healthchecks to consider tail latency. I'll open infra ticket.

sarah (eng-runtime): runbook items: add a step to try rollback of runtime canary when 5xx increases and backend latency correlated; add command snippets and ownership. also suggest adding a dedicated alert for partner fanout amplification.

omar (oncall): action items and owners:
- omar: finalize customer blurb, handoff monitoring to oncall-backup in 30m.
- lia: autoscaler policy change ticket + infra-runbook update.
- sarah: create hotfix PR for a defensive sleep on backend client + expanded timeouts (PR-1489).
- tomas (product): coordinate communication with partner-acme and confirm whether they can stagger batch.
- pm-ryan: notify support, update status page if required.
- infra-bot: collect logs and save a short-term snapshot for postmortem: `logs/export --since=15m --tag=urgent-gateway-2100123456`.

oncall-backup: taking over monitoring for the next 2h. omar — feel free to ping me if anything degrades.

omar (oncall): handing off. summary: scaled ASG, enabled circuit breaker, throttled partner, rolled back runtime canary. visible error rate down to 2.9% and trending down.

tomas (product): will reach out to partner-acme and request staggered batches; will confirm by EOD.

pm-ryan: thanks team. please add short runbook PRs and the hotfix. we should also tune the alert to fire earlier (alert from 10%->5% with longer evaluation window?) liason to SRE team to decide.

lia (infra): opening infra ticket INF-2100. will add the autoscaler change and the alert tuning proposal.

sarah (eng-runtime): created hotfix PR-1489: defensive timeouts + added unit test for client backoff. linking here: https://git.redwood/pr/1489.

omar (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" in the ticket. will leave channel open for followups. great response everyone. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. reference: incidents/2100123456.

oncall-backup: acknowledged. leaving a note: will review logs and attach an initial timeline in 4h.

sarah (eng-runtime): quick note for postmortem: add verification step for canary promotion metrics (include tail latency, rpc timeouts) and an automated rollback trigger if RPC timeout rate > 1% for 5m.

omar (oncall): agreed. adding to action list. we'll meet tomorrow for incident triage.

pm-ryan: closing loop: I notified support and drafted the status page update; will post after product confirms partner communication.

— end of thread —
